group.title: A revised fitness schedule
group.passage: M1: This is a message for members attending evening classes at Riverside Fitness. Our upstairs studio will be closed for floor repairs this Thursday. Most classes will move to the ground-floor studio, but we cannot accommodate the final class because its equipment is fixed upstairs. Please look at the Thursday schedule in the app. The class starting at eight will therefore be canceled, and anyone who booked it will receive a class credit automatically. The two earlier classes will run at their usual times, though each will have fewer places than normal. If you no longer plan to attend, please cancel your reservation so another member can join. The upstairs studio is expected to reopen on Friday afternoon.
group.passageZh:
星期四晚間課表：晚上六點——伸展與平衡；晚上七點——初階舞蹈；晚上八點——室內飛輪。

這則訊息給 Riverside Fitness 的晚間課程會員。樓上教室星期四修地板而關閉。大部分課程移到一樓，但最後一堂所需設備固定在樓上，無法移課。請看應用程式的星期四課表。八點開始的課將取消，預約者會自動獲得可抵用另一堂課的資格。前兩堂照常但名額較少。不來的人請取消預約，讓其他會員參加。樓上教室預計星期五下午重新開放。
